_comment: Curated community announcements for the board. date is YYYY-MM-DD (US Eastern) — when it was posted, not necessarily an event date. title is required; body/poster/link are optional. Recency affects visual prominence, not existence — see recencyTier() in board.js for the current/recent/old day thresholds. Same _example convention as events.json: entries with "_example": true are ignored by the site.
